QuestInfo.name: The Best Gift is a Sweet Bribe
QuestInfo.0: Vincent is making sure Vicky's bribe is as bribe-y as possible. Help him just a bit more and you might learn something about the Spirit of Rock...
QuestInfo.1: The only things Vincent still needs are some Orange Mushroom Dolls. They're a really hot item right now, so bring him 65 Orange Mushroom Dolls.
QuestInfo.2: You successfully collected all the Orange Mushroom Dolls Vincent asked for.

0.0: Now, a 'gift' for the last judge. I think we're gonna need to find some #bOrange Mushroom Dolls#k.
0.1: I can't wait to see Vicky's expression when she wins! She's gonna be so happy... I mean... I mean I can't wait to see how happy you look when you meet the Spirit of Rock... yes...

yes.0: Aw man, you're the best. Right, well now I need you to get me #b65#k #bOrange Mushroom Dolls#k.

no.0: Please, this is my last favor to ask of you! I promise!

1.0: I just know Vicky's gonna win! I can't wait for her to like me!

0.msg: Awesome, you found some Orange Mushroom Dolls! Great job, buddy.

1.msg: This cuddly little thing is the splitting image of Vicky!

2.msg: Um, Vincent... I don't think that's a compliment...

3.msg: Anyway, we're  all good to go now!

item.0: We can't miss this opportunity! The opportunity for me to capture Vicky's heart... er... I mean... I mean for you to meet the Spirit of Rock! Yes... yes, that's what I meant...
